hints: For $x > 0$, $f(x) = \frac{3}{2x + 1}$ decreases from $3$ towards $0$, so $0 < f(x) < 3$.
walkthrough:
Determine the range of $f(x) = \frac{3}{2x + 1}$ on the domain $x > 0$:
$$\text{As } x \to 0^+, \quad f(x) \to 3; \qquad \text{As } x \to \infty, \quad f(x) \to 0$$
$$\text{Range of } f: \quad 0 < f(x) < 3 \quad (\text{or } (0, 3))$$

Determine the range of $g(x) = \frac{1}{x} + 2$ on the domain $x > 0$:
$$\text{As } x \to \infty, \quad g(x) \to 2; \qquad \text{As } x \to 0^+, \quad g(x) \to \infty$$
$$\text{Range of } g: \quad g(x) > 2 \quad (\text{or } (2, \infty))$$

hints: Substitute $g(x) = \frac{1}{x} + 2$ into $f(x) = \frac{3}{2x + 1}$ and simplify numerator and denominator.
walkthrough:
Simplify the complex fraction by multiplying numerator and denominator by $x$:
$$fg(x) = \frac{3x}{5x + 2}$$

Set $y = \frac{3x}{5x + 2}$ and rearrange to make $x$ the subject:
$$y(5x + 2) = 3x \implies 5xy + 2y = 3x$$
$$3x - 5xy = 2y \implies x(3 - 5y) = 2y$$
$$x = \frac{2y}{3 - 5y}$$

Write the inverse function in terms of $x$:
$$(fg)^{-1}(x) = \frac{2x}{3 - 5x}$$
